title: Survey of the current status of psychocardiological consultation and liaison services at cardiology clinics in Germany.
summary: The aim of this study is to systematically assess the current status of psychocardiological care for patients with heart disease. Influencing factors and the types of financing mechanisms will be determined. Employees at German cardiological centers will be interviewed using an online survey. In a subsequent phase, a voluntary structured interview may be conducted.
conditions: Status of psychocardiological consultation and liaison services; these cannot be attributed to a specific coding system.

interventions.name: Participants will complete an online survey, which will be distributed to over 500 cardiological clinics and departments. Additionally, a structured interview may be conducted with a stratified subsample (with participants providing their contact information voluntarily during the online survey).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
For the online survey, the heads of all cardiology clinics or departments in Germany, as well as all members of the German Society of Cardiology (DGK) with relevant affiliations, will be contacted.
Exclusion criteria:
No cardiological centers outside of Germany are included in this study.
